title: [epic] Google Cloud Storage block store backend
description:
## Why
GCS is the dominant object store in Google Cloud and GCP-aligned deployments. Like Azure, GCS has a native API distinct from S3; using it natively gives access to GCS-specific features (object lifecycle, uniform bucket-level access, Workload Identity).

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "gcs"` config: bucket name, credential (service account key file or application default credentials)
- `GcsStore: IpfsStore` backed by `object_store` GCS provider or `google-cloud-storage` crate
- Object name = CID base32; content-type = `application/octet-stream`
- Startup: verify bucket reachable and writable
- Integration test against fake-gcs-server via docker-compose
- RUNBOOK section
